_meta.note: Swap interop bible. Prices indicative Oct 2026 — re-verify per city. Availability heuristic documented in swap.js.

networks.name: Gogoro Network
networks.notes: Densest network globally (TW). India = delivery-fleet beachhead. 24/7 cabins, QR + subscription.

networks.name: Sun Mobility (SwapX)
networks.interop: Piaggio, Mahindra Treo fleets, Bounce, Zomato/Swiggy pilots
networks.rushPattern: 11:30-14:30 & 18:30-21:30 low (0.5x); fleet contract riders get priority queue
networks.notes: Interoperable QaaS: same station serves 2W+3W. Fleet dashboards. Biggest IN swap footprint.

networks.name: Ola Hypercharger + Swap (Gen3)
networks.notes: Hybrid: Hypercharger fast-DC + swap pilot. Closed network = reliable for Ola owners, useless for others. ROI engine flags lock-in.

networks.name: CATL Chocolate (Choco-SEB)
networks.notes: Only swap standard that spans 2W AND 4W with same block family. Watch for IN rollout with OEM bundles.

networks.name: NIO Power Swap
networks.interop: NIO + Geely/Yiyi MERGED network from Sept 2026 (shared cabins, unified app auth)
networks.rushPattern: Golden-week / holiday peaks; urban lunch low 0.7x
networks.notes: 4W automated drive-through. Sept 2026 Geely/Yiyi merge = single largest 4W swap map. EU/CN travelers benefit most.

networks.name: Geely / Yiyi (E-Energee)
networks.notes: GB/T-native cabins + adapter bays for CCS2 visitors at merged sites.

networks.name: Honda Power Pack Exchanger e:
networks.interop: Activa e:, QC1 fixed excluded, U-Go SEA

networks.name: Bounce Infinity
networks.notes: Kirana-store density model — great last-mile, thin highways.

networks.name: Hero Vida (removable+swap)
networks.notes: Dual-mode: home charge OR dealer swap — ROI engine compares both.

roiDefaults.swapPriceNote: Swap Rs 60-80 vs 3-hr charge Rs 40: swap wins when rider time > Rs 13/hr. For fleets it always wins at rush.

interopWarnings: Sun pack does NOT fit Gogoro cabin (different latch + BMS handshake). Never route cross-network swap.
Ola closed network: non-Ola 2W must be routed to charge, not Ola swap.
CATL Choco 4W blocks do NOT fit NIO cabins despite Sept 2026 app merge — app interop ≠ physical interop. Engine enforces physical fit.
NIO+Geely merge = shared discovery + payment, separate robot lanes. Plan extra 5 min at merged mega-sites (queue model).
